provisional.DV2-BOARD-FIGURE: R-65: the owner did not name this figure; it is the value drawn on a VF, PT, RF or W board of the 16 Oct 2026 designs, loaded as a setting until the owner confirms it.
provisional.REF-CLAIM-DAYS: R-65: no board or ruling gives the number of days after sign-up in which a person can claim a referral code. 7 matches the 7-day reward hold the RF boards draw.
provisional.W44-PASS-LINES: G-804: the lines under a pass on W44 (the board draws three under the Maker Pass, priority: Entry to the event and the maker area; A table to show your work; Priority when places are given out). No pass has lines until the owner confirms them; an admin sets them here, and a pass with none shows none.
provisional.PLAN-TRANSFER-WINDOW: TIER-05: no ruling says how long a person has to send the money for a purchase they chose to pay by bank transfer. 24 hours covers an evening's delay and a bank's slow day; nothing is taken when it lapses, and any money sent stays in the wallet.
provisional.EVENT-ORDER-CAP: EVENTS-13: the lead's ruling of 17 Oct 2026 sets 10 open paid ticket orders per buyer per event (a refunded ticket order costs WAWU the provider's charge, R-31). It stays until the owner names the figure.
provisional.POINTS-JOB-MAX-RUN: POINTS-03: no ruling says how long an AI job may run before the points held for it are given back. 30 minutes is longer than any one job the plan prices (the longest audio is 10 minutes) and short enough that a dead job does not keep a person's points for long.
provisional.VOICE-INTRO-MAX-CHARS: VOICE-01: no ruling or board sizes a Voice Intro script. The sample is 30 seconds and a minute of speech is 900 characters (AITOOLS-CHARS-PER-MINUTE), so 500 characters is about 33 seconds: a short bio, said once.
provisional.VOICE-NAME-PREVIEWS: VOICE-01: the free name preview calls the voice provider and no ruling limits it. 20 an hour is far more than anyone needs to get a spelling right, and stops a loop from running up the provider's bill.
provisional.VOICE-SAMPLE-SECONDS: VERIFY-03 and FIX-95: no ruling names the shortest or longest Voice Intro recording. 30 seconds is the board's (VF9 'Record 30 seconds') and the Hub's own wording; 15 is half of it, since the boards show 8 seconds as too short. The owner may change both.
provisional.AITOOLS-CHARS-PER-MINUTE: AITOOLS-01: the PT2 board prices a script of 132 characters as one minute and no ruling says how long a minute of speech is in text. 900 characters is about 150 words at a steady pace (an average word with its space is about 6 characters), so the 5,000 character limit is about six minutes, inside the 10 minute cap. AITOOLS-02: Quick voice reads the same words at the same pace on a faster model, so its minute is the same 900 characters until the owner says otherwise.
provisional.AITOOLS-LIMITS: AITOOLS-03: no ruling or board sizes the two prompt tools. The description starts at the plan's own per-job character cap (points.max_chars_per_job), not a new figure, and the longest sound (30 seconds) and track (300 seconds) are the provider's own maximums (docs/elevenlabs/API-FACTS.md, Sound effects and Music), so the owner may only lower them. AITOOLS-04: the largest file for Captions or Clean audio (ai.input_max_bytes) is 500 MB, the smaller of the provider's documented limits (500 MB for the voice isolator, under 5.0 GB for transcripts); the owner may lower it.
provisional.AITOOLS-COPY-CONFIRM: AITOOLS-04 round 4: no ruling or board says how long to wait before believing that the voice provider has deleted a transcript. The real provider answers a read 404 for about a second after a delete and then shows the transcript again (8 of 9 real jobs, 24 Oct 2026), so the Hub counts a transcript as deleted only after two reads that say 404: the first 10 minutes after the job ended, the second 5 minutes after the first. The owner confirms both figures; an admin may change them.
provisional.AITOOLS-DUB-LANGUAGES: AITOOLS-05: the list of languages Dubbing offers is the provider's own, read from its help page "Which languages are supported in Dubbing" on 24 Oct 2026 (the Dubbing v2 list, which is the model the Hub uses when it names none): 94 base languages, one line each as a language code, a space and the name. Region forms (en-US, pt-BR, es-MX and the like) are not offered. The owner may shorten the list or add forms; a language outside it is refused with nothing held.
provisional.AITOOLS-DUB-RUN: AITOOLS-05: the provider states no time for a dub and no real run has been made (NOT RUN). 60 minutes is longer than a dub of the longest file the plan allows (10 minutes of audio) is expected to take, and short enough that a dub that never ends does not keep a person's points for long. It is the dub's own limit, not the 30 minutes of the other tools (points.job_max_run_minutes). The owner may change it after a measured run.
provisional.CONTENT-REVIEW-HOURS: FIX-110 (G-ME-08-3): nothing measures how long a review takes, and no ruling names a figure. M25 draws 'Usually takes: A few hours', so 4 hours is the board's 'a few' as a number an admin can change; the app words it as 'About 4 hours'.
provisional.ABROAD-FEE: NUV-11: R-10 says the user pays the provider's fee plus WAWU's on top, from config, and no ruling or board names WAWU's fee for sending abroad. 0 until the owner names it. It is charged in naira from the naira wallet on a send from the naira wallet; a send from a foreign account pays ABROAD-FOREIGN-FEE from that account instead.
provisional.ABROAD-FOREIGN-FEE: WALLET-42: R-10 says the user pays the provider's fee plus WAWU's on top, from config, and no ruling names WAWU's fee for a send from a foreign account. None until the owner names it (a fee of 0 per currency and way). It is taken from the same foreign account the money leaves, in that currency, for everyone (lead ruling, owner may override): the fee follows the source account, and a send from the naira wallet keeps the naira fee above.
provisional.ABROAD-LIMITS: NUV-11: no ruling or board names a most per send or per day for sending abroad. None until the owner names them (the provider's own limits still apply); an admin may set one per currency.
provisional.ABROAD-CORRIDORS: NUV-11: on 24 Oct 2026 Nuvion's dev server refused a transfer to Uganda, Mexico, Singapore and Hong Kong ("not supported for currency yet"). They are listed as not available until an admin empties this list, which is the day Nuvion switches them on.
provisional.CAPITAL-ENABLED: NUV-12 (owner-asked control): Capital is on by default, as the owner asked on 24 Oct 2026 (R-84). An admin can switch it off here (0): new orders close (the product list, a reservation and a confirmation answer that Capital is not available) and a person with nothing held loses the Wallet tab row, but what a person already holds can still be read and withdrawn, and the row stays for them.
